edges.reason: msg.sender indexes pendingWithdrawals to determine the withdrawn amount
msg.sender becomes the new punk owner in buyPunk
msg.sender is checked as the current owner in transferPunk
msg.sender must equal the stored bidder in withdrawBidForPunk
getPunk assigns the punk to msg.sender
setInitialOwner ignores msg.sender because the owner require is commented out, allowing arbitrary initial assignment
block.timestamp participates in keccak256 pseudo randomness, a timestamp dependency
initiateUnlock computes releaseTimes from now, making timelocks miner influenceable
pendingWithdrawals is read and zeroed before the ether transfer in withdraw
withdraw hands control to msg.sender through an ether transfer
A malicious msg.sender can re-enter withdraw while the transfer is executing
withdrawBidForPunk sends ether to msg.sender
The bidder receiving ether can re-enter the market contract
sendValue forwards value to an arbitrary recipient via a low level call
An untrusted recipient contract can re-enter the calling function
_functionCallWithValue performs an unchecked-externally-callable low level call with value
An arbitrary target contract can re-enter during the low level call
Profitable.withdraw transfers the whole balance to the supplied address
simpleRedeem calls the external ERC20 mint and burn interfaces
External call to the punk token occurs before simpleRedeem state changes complete
directRedeem burns ERC20 through an external call
External token call in directRedeem can re-enter the vault
mintPunk refunds the bounty difference with a native transfer to the sender
transferPunk decrements balanceOf[msg.sender] without SafeMath, risking underflow
acceptBidForPunk decrements balanceOf[seller] without SafeMath
getBurnBounty subtracts numTokens and loop counters from reserves length without SafeMath
The owner state is never compared in setInitialOwner because the require is commented out
setInitialOwners is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner)
msg.sender is compared against the owner state variable
verifiedIntegrators is written by the onlyOwner setIntegrator function
verifiedControllers is written by the onlyOwner setController function
directRedeem is gated by the onlyController modifier reading verifiedControllers
setMintFees overwrites the mintFees array
securityLevel determines the delay applied in initiateUnlock
initiateUnlock writes the releaseTimes mapping entry
mintPunk delegates to the private _mintPunk worker
_mintPunk performs an external call into CryptoPunksMarket.buyPunk
mintPunkMultiple performs external buyPunk calls on the market contract
redeemPunk delegates to the private _redeemPunk worker
_redeemPunk uses getPseudoRand output as the index into reserves
migrate makes external transferPunk calls into the CryptoPunksMarket contract
isContract writes the local size variable from the extcodesize assembly call
mintAndRedeem invokes the mint worker before redemption
mintAndRedeem invokes the redeem worker after minting

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter only exists to feed the low level value transfer performed by sendValue
The amount parameter is only used as the value of the call inside sendValue
The destination parameter is consumed entirely by the transferPunk state updates
The bid storage pointer is a local helper for the punkBids mutation done by transferPunk
The payable destination is only used by the balance transfer in Profitable.withdraw
The cached balance local exists solely to be transferred by Profitable.withdraw
The tokenIds array is the input driving the batch mint loop in mintPunkMultiple
The local token id is read from reserves and removed within simpleRedeem
The size local is assigned directly by the extcodesize assembly operation
The account parameter is only used to update verifiedIntegrators and the integrator count
